lead_independence.headline: St. Lucie County relocates flood shelters to help public schools reopen
lead_independence.lead: After opening temporary shelters Nov. 3 for residents displaced by flooding the day before, St. Lucie County Emergency Management is moving the shelters Wednesday morning to help St. Lucie public schools reopen. The general population shelter is moving from Northport K-8 School in Port St. Lucie to the Havert L. Fenn Center in Fort Pierce, while the special medical needs shelter is relocating from the Fenn Center.

lead_independence.headline: Martin County judge rejects dismissal of Palm City dog trainer Nikki Camerlengo’s cruelty case
lead_independence.lead: A Martin County judge on Wednesday rejected a motion to dismiss the felony animal cruelty case against Palm City dog trainer Nikki Camerlengo, allowing the prosecution to continue after at least nine trial delays since her arrest more than two years ago.
